layout_structure.title_text: Focus-N-Fix: Region-Aware Fine-Tuning for Text-to-Image Generation
layout_structure.layout_description: This is a title slide with a clean, white background. The main title is centered in the middle of the slide, rendered in a large, bold, blue font. Below the title, a list of numerous authors is centered in a smaller black font. Further down, the conference information 'CVPR 2025 Highlight' is highlighted in red, followed by specific poster session details in black. In the top-left corner, there is a small rectangular image showing a city skyline at sunset with a CVPR logo. The top-right area contains a horizontal arrangement of institutional logos, including Google Research, Northwestern University, The University of Texas at Austin, Google DeepMind, and Google. A small red disclaimer text is positioned at the bottom center of the slide. The overall text density is light, focusing on key identifying information.

layout_structure.layout_type: single column with diagram and bullets
layout_structure.layout_description: The slide features a large, bold blue title at the top-left. The central portion of the slide is dominated by a complex horizontal flowchart/diagram illustrating the 'Focus-N-Fix' methodology. This diagram starts on the left with input blocks for 'Prompt' and 'Initial Noise', which feed into 'LoRA Params' and 'Pre-Trained Params'. These parameters generate two versions of an analog clock image: 'Fine-Tuned' and 'Pre-Trained'. These images are then used to calculate a 'Reward' and identify a 'Problematic Region' mask, both of which contribute to a 'Fine-Tuning Objective' equation shown in a box on the right. A separate 'Regional Constraint' box below the objective visually depicts the subtraction of the two clock images. Below the main diagram, there are two primary bullet points with one sub-bullet that provide textual explanations of the mathematical components. The slide is anchored by a solid blue footer bar containing a summary sentence in white text. The layout uses a white background with various colored boxes (green, yellow, orange) to categorize different parts of the process, and the text density is moderate.

layout_structure.layout_type: single column with diagram and bullets
layout_structure.layout_description: The slide features a large, bold blue title at the top-left. The main body of the slide is dominated by a complex flowchart diagram in the upper half, illustrating the 'Focus-N-Fix' method. This diagram flows from left to right, starting with inputs like 'Prompt' and 'Initial Noise', passing through 'Sample' blocks (LoRA and Pre-Trained Params), and resulting in 'Fine-Tuned' and 'Pre-Trained' clock images. It further branches into 'Reward' and 'Problematic Region' (mask) components, culminating in a 'Fine-Tuning Objective' equation and a 'Regional Constraint' visualization on the right. Solid black arrows indicate the forward path, while dashed red arrows indicate backpropagation. Below the diagram, there are two primary bullet points explaining the traditional fine-tuning objective versus the proposed regional constraint, which includes a mathematical formula. The second bullet point has a nested sub-bullet. At the bottom of the slide, a full-width blue footer bar contains a white summary sentence describing the method's use of a reward model and mask for localized correction. The background is plain white, and the text density is moderate.

layout_structure.layout_type: single column with title and side-by-side figures
layout_structure.layout_description: The slide follows a top-down structure starting with a large, bold blue title 'Human Evaluation Results' positioned at the top-left. Below the title, there are two primary bullet points in dark grey text that provide context and a key takeaway. The main content area consists of two side-by-side bar charts. The left chart is titled 'Over-Sexualization Reward' in red and compares five different methods across 'Over-Sexualization' and 'Artifact/T2I Alignment' metrics. The right chart is titled 'Artifact Reward' in red and compares four methods across 'Artifact' and 'T2I Alignment' metrics. Both charts feature a legend in the top-right corner and use a consistent color palette (grey, light green, green, purple, and a blue-striped bar for 'Focus-N-Fix'). A red caption at the bottom center clarifies that 'Higher Human Preference Scores are Preferred'. The overall background is white, and a small yellow icon is visible in the extreme top-right corner.

layout_structure.layout_type: single column with title and side-by-side charts
layout_structure.layout_description: The slide has a clean, white background with a large, bold blue title 'Human Evaluation Results' positioned at the top-left. Below the title, there are two black bullet points; the first describes the evaluation setup (100 prompts), and the second highlights the performance of 'Focus-N-Fix'. The central part of the slide features two side-by-side bar charts. The left chart is titled 'Over-Sexualization Reward' in red, and the right chart is titled 'Artifact Reward' in red. Both charts use a vertical y-axis for 'Human Preference Score' and compare five different methods, which are color-coded and listed in a legend: 'Safe Latent Diffusion' (light gray), 'Reward Guidance' (light green), 'Reward Guidance (w/ Regional Constraints)' (medium green), 'DraFT' (purple), and 'Focus-N-Fix' (blue with diagonal hatching). At the bottom center, a red caption clarifies that 'Higher Human Preference Scores are Preferred'. The text density is moderate, and the layout is balanced and symmetrical.

A solid blue footer bar spans the bottom of the slide, containing a single line of white text that summarizes the key takeaway: that the Focus-N-Fix method generalizes to these different reward functions. The layout is highly symmetrical and uses color-coding (red for prompts/rewards, blue for title/footer) to organize information clearly.
